mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, stock, category, brand, store_id, image, status, is_hot, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, category, tags, images, videos, likes_count, comments_count, status, create_time, update_time, is_top, is_hot, exposure_score, views_count, shares_count, image_count, cover_image FROM post WHERE status = 1 AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM service_stores WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY created_at DESC
